For the past week Jalin has had an appt everyday with a specialist in different areas. Its been incredibly stressful and at times I felt so defeated and emotional. On the verge of tears several times. 

If it wasnt for all the people that we were in the presence of I probably wouldve broken down. Every single doctor, nurse, assistant and even the other patients were just as kind and loving as they could be. They saved me, truly. 

Our country is a mess, many are struggling and people on the internet are just at each others throats, but all of these people chose to show kindness and love towards others. I am so grateful for that. 

So if youre one of those people who are choosing to be kind and loving to everyone right now, thank you. You may not realize it, but youre making a huge difference. Believe me.

You truly never know what someone is going through. Your kindness may be exactly what holds them together during a moment they feel like theyre gonna fall apart. 

Please dont stop. ❤❤❤
